title: Point Four Reset Block Battle (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance fusion 136bpm heavy bongo conga djembe slap bass spanish guitar pads synth lead trance buildup tribal claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro umpire voice]
Four all kitchen line battle
They speed up the ball at chest
Time to absorb not to swing
Reset is the answer best

[Verse 1 commentary]
Ball comes fast at the chest
No backswing is the test
Paddle out front face open
Knees bend low feet still hopin
Vamos vamos absorb the pace
Uno dos tres soft face
Deflect like a cushion soft
Ball floats back into the soft loft

[Pre-Chorus]
Reset and reset
Slow and slow
Reset and reset
Go with the flow

[Chorus]
Point four reset block point four reset block
Absorb the pace absorb the pace
Point four reset block point four reset block
Vamos amigos win the race

[Verse 2 coaching]
If you swing back at the speed up
The ball goes long over the cup
If you back up off the line
You give them more time fine
Uno dos tres feet still
Mano blanda no thrill
Grip pressure two out of ten
Ball hits the face and floats again

[Bridge]
The reset block is the equalizer
When they speed up the realizer
Feet still face open soft hands
Ball floats back to the kitchen lands

[Chorus]
Point four reset block point four reset block
Absorb the pace absorb the pace
Point four reset block point four reset block
Vamos amigos win the race

[Outro]
Reset and reset
Soft face
Reset and reset
Slow the pace
